title.narrative: Air Quality Improvement in the Greater Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region—Regional Emission-Reduction and Pollution-Control Facility

description.narrative: The proposed project is the third in a multiyear, multisector Asian Development Bank (ADB) support program for air quality improvement in the greater Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei (BTH) region. The first loan, approved in 2015, focused on reforming policy and strengthening regulatory capacity in Hebei province. The second loan, approved in 2016, targeted better access to finance, especially for small and medium sized-enterprises, to scale up investments in pollution-reduction projects in the region. This third project will complement the previous projects and will directly help remove barriers to deploying high technologies that could reduce air pollution from industries, urban infrastructure, and agriculture.

description.narrative: Air pollution reduced and high technology deployed across the greater BTH region.

At least (i) 2.2 million tons of CO2, (ii) 20,000 tons of SO2, (iii) 3,000 tons of NOx, and (iv) 3,000 tons of PM2.5 emissions avoided per year Progress/Status: It is estimated that the project will achieve (i) 2,126,880 tons of carbon dioxide, (ii) 18,835 tons of sulfur dioxide, (iii) 6,611 tons of nitrogen oxide, and (iv) 1,241,887 tons of particulate matter emissions avoided per year, assuming all 16 subprojects operate at full capacity. Data Source: Subproject completion reports prepared by CECEP Actual value:

At least 1 million tons of standard coal equivalent saved. Progress/Status: It is estimated that the project will achieve 1,049,430 tons of standard coal saved. Data Source: Semiannual implementation reports prepared by CECEP Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Capacity of key stakeholders to deploy high technologies for pollution reduction in the greater BTH region improved Indicator: At least 200 individuals from five key stakeholders trained in high technologies, selection of appropriate business models, and investment decision-making Achievement: 200 Progress/Status: Completed in June 2023. Various trainings, workshops, and webinars in areas such as high technology, selection of appropriate business models, investment decision-making, and ESMS implementation have been held for the Project since its launch.
By June 2023, more than 200 individuals have benefitted from the trainings, workshops, and webinars conducted. The stakeholders include PMO, members at CECEP and CECEP Fund, environmental and social specialists at CECEP Hundred and CECEPEC, project managers and financial managers from sub-borrowers, investment managers from co-financers, professionals from cooperative entrusted banks and account banks, officials from local government investment platforms, etc.
Data Source: Semiannual implementation reports prepared by CECEP

Output: High technologies to reduce air pollution in distributed energy, heating, transport, and heavily polluting and high energy consuming industries deployed Indicator: At least (i) construction of three biogas and/or hydrogen production facilities adopting circular economy approach, (ii) biogas production from two waste treatment facilities, (iii) two smart micro-grids constructed in industrial parks, (iv) heat-pump based district heating provided to 2 million square meters of floor area, (v) completion of energy-efficiency measures in five heavily polluting and high energy consuming industries subprojects, and (vi) new energy-based low-emission transport projects. Progress/Status: (i) Completed in December 2021. Three biogas and/or hydrogen production facilities were constructed--(a) Tianjin Dongli Biomasss Energy and Comprehensive Waste Treatment Subprojects (biogas production) implemented in 2020; (b) Shandong Jimo Kitchen Waste-to-Biogas ad Recycled Utilization Subprojects (Biogas production) implemented in 2021; and (c) Energy conservation, emission, reduction and utilization of waste heat and hydrogen Project in Bohua Chemical Industry Park (hydrogen product), implemented in 2021.
(ii) Completed in July 2021. Two biogas production facilities were constructed--(a) Tianjin Dongli Biomass Energy and Comprehensive Waste Treatment Subproject, implemented in 2020; and (b) Shandong Jimo Kitchen Waste-to-Biogas and Recycled Utilization Subproject, implemented in 2021.
(iii) Completed in December 2021. Two smart micro-grids constructed in industrial parks--(a) Tianjin Dongli Biomass Energy and Comprehensive Waste Treatment Subproject, implemented in 2020; and (b) Energy Conservation, Emission Reduction and Utilization of Waste Heat and Hydrogen Project in Bohua Chemical Industry Park, implemented in 2021.
(iv) Completed in September 2021. The Jiaozhou City Shaoni New City Sewage Heat Pump Heating/Cooling Subproject delivered heat-pump based district heating to a total floor area of 2.45 million square meters during its implementation in 2021.
(v) Completed in December 2021, the energy efficiency initiatives targeted heavily polluting and high energy-consuming industries. These included: (a) China Great Wall Aluminum Cooperation Waste Heat Utilization District Heating Subproject, implemented in 2019; (b) Shouguang City Power Plant Waste Heat Utilization District Heating Subproject, implemented in 2020; (c) Hebei Yu County Residual Heat Utilization and Emission Reduction Subproject, implemented in 2021; (d) Hebei Xingtang Residual Heat Utilization and Emission Reduction Subproject, implemented in 2021; and (e) Energy Conservation, Emission Reduction and Utilization of Waste Heat and Hydrogen Project in Bohua Chemical Industry Park, implemented in 2021.
(vi) Completed in November 2021. the Procurement of Electric Vehicles for Official Use Subproject implemented in 2021.
Data Source: Subproject completion reports prepared by CECEP Actual value:

CECEP Fund has prepared and disseminated the guidelines on the selection, appraisal, and implementation of subprojects , including investment management implementation rules and risk management implementation rules for ADB-funded projects in 2020. Data Source: Semiannual implementation reports prepared by CECEP Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: Not prepared Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: Not prepared Target year: 2024 Target value: Prepared Actual value: prepared

Output: Regional Emission-Reduction and Pollution-Control Facility established Indicator: The facility comprising regional, municipal or provincial and technology- or industry-specific funds totaling €428.0 million established. Progress/Status: The establishment of the facility and various funds started June 2019, with the latest fund established in November 2021 (Bohua Industry Fund).
The facility (CECEP ADB Industry Investment Fund) was established on 14 June 2019 with a registered capital of CNY3,328 million (Euro428 million).
The Regional Fund (CECEP ADB Weilan Industry Investment Fund) was established on 31 December 2019.
The Local Fund (CECEP ADB Jinxin Equity Investment Fund) was established in August 2020.
The Technology- or Industry-Specific Fund (Bohua Industry Fund) was established in November 2021.
The cumulative ADB loan disbursement from the Facility and Sub-funds has reached Euro318.52 million. Data Source: Semiannual implementation reports prepared by CECEP Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: Not established Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: Not established Target year: 2025 Target value: Established
